name: Chimpering
summary: Chimpering is an exhilarating fan-made expansion for Gorilla Tag, featuring an intense and dynamic take on the traditional tag gameplay. This mod introduces new movement mechanics, unique player abilities, and vibrant, fast-paced action, creating a thrilling experience for both casual and competitive players.
